name: Grain Term Structure: Roll-Yield Opportunities
description: Compares carry (front/back - 1) across corn (ZC), soybeans (ZS), and wheat (ZW) to identify which grains are in backwardation vs contango and where roll-yield opportunities exist. Shows current carry vs 52-week range, carry time series, and carry distribution per grain.
source:
# =============================================================================
# GRAIN TERM STRUCTURE: ROLL-YIELD OPPORTUNITIES
# =============================================================================
#
# Compares carry (front/back - 1) across corn (ZC), soybeans (ZS), wheat (ZW).
# Positive carry = backwardation (roll yield positive — front > deferred).
# Negative carry = contango (roll cost — front < deferred).
#
# DATA NOTES:
#   - ZC: primary asset via market_data_source + futures_continuation
#   - ZS, ZW: reference futures piped through futures_continuation
#   - NoAdjustment: preserves real price levels (not needed for carry, but
#     consistent with cross-commodity analysis pattern)
#   - spread_depth=1: enables cont.carry and cont.spread outputs
#   - LiquidityBased rollover: most accurate front-month selection
#
# OUTPUTS:
#   1. Summary table — current carry + 52-week high/low per grain
#   2. Carry comparison line chart — all 3 grains, zero line anchor
#   3. Carry distribution boxplot — where does current carry sit historically?
#   4. Event markers — ZC regime flips (backwardation ↔ contango)
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary: ZC (Corn) ---
src = market_data_source()()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zc_carry = zc_cont.carry

# --- Reference: ZS (Soybeans) ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)

zs_carry = zs_cont.carry

# --- Reference: ZW (CBOT Soft Red Winter Wheat) ---
zw_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZW')()
zw_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zw_ref.o, zw_ref.h, zw_ref.l, zw_ref.c, zw_ref.v, zw_ref.oi, zw_ref.s)

zw_carry = zw_cont.carry

# --- Timestamp ---
ts = index()

# --- 52-week rolling high/low carry per grain (period-agnostic: use rolling 252) ---
# Using rolling 252 = 1 trading year. Works on any date range.
zc_carry_high = ma(period=1)(zc_carry)   # placeholder — use max/min below
zs_carry_high = ma(period=1)(zs_carry)
zw_carry_high = ma(period=1)(zw_carry)

# Rolling 252-day max/min for 52-week range
zc_52w_high = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(zc_carry)
zc_52w_low  = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(zc_carry)
zs_52w_high = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(zs_carry)
zs_52w_low  = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(zs_carry)
zw_52w_high = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(zw_carry)
zw_52w_low  = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(zw_carry)

# --- ZC regime: backwardation vs contango ---
# Backwardation: carry crosses above zero
# Contango: carry crosses below zero
zc_in_backwardation = zc_carry > 0
zc_regime_flip_to_back   = crossover(zc_carry, 0)
zc_regime_flip_to_contango = crossover(0, zc_carry)   # crossover(threshold, series) = series crosses below threshold

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Current carry + 52-week range per grain
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Grain Carry: Backwardation (+) vs Contango (-)',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Corn (ZC)', 'Soybeans (ZS)', 'Wheat (ZW)'],
        col_headers=['Current Carry', '52W High', '52W Low'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='ZC current carry (front/back - 1)', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='ZC 52-week carry high', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='ZC 52-week carry low', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='ZS current carry (front/back - 1)', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='ZS 52-week carry high', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='ZS 52-week carry low', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='ZW current carry (front/back - 1)', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='ZW 52-week carry high', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='ZW 52-week carry low', grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='Grain Carry',
    order=0
)(zc_carry, zc_52w_high, zc_52w_low, zs_carry, zs_52w_high, zs_52w_low, zw_carry, zw_52w_high, zw_52w_low)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Carry Comparison — All 3 Grains Over Time
# Zero line separates backwardation (above) from contango (below)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Which Grain Has Roll-Yield? Carry Across Corn, Beans & Wheat',
    category='Grain Carry',
    y_axis_label='Carry (Front/Back - 1)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat (Contango/Backwardation boundary)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Corn (ZC)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Soybeans (ZS)', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Wheat (ZW)', color=Color.Amber)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zc_carry, zs_carry, zw_carry))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Carry Distribution — Where Does Current Carry Sit Historically?
# Boxplot shows median, IQR, and outliers for each grain's carry history
# =============================================================================
boxplot(
    title='Carry Distribution: Is Current Carry Extreme or Normal?',
    category='Grain Carry',
    series_names=['Corn (ZC)', 'Soybeans (ZS)', 'Wheat (ZW)'],
    y_axis_label='Carry (Front/Back - 1)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    show_data_labels=True,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Amber],
    order=2
)(values=(zc_carry, zs_carry, zw_carry))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Event Markers — ZC Regime Flips
# Marks each time corn crosses from contango into backwardation (or vice versa)
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='ZC Carry Regime Flip',
        icon='ActivityIcon',
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry at Flip', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                       card_color_map={'Success': ['Backwardation'], 'Error': ['Contango']}),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(zc_carry,
  'Backwardation' if zc_in_backwardation else 'Contango',
  zc_regime_flip_to_back or zc_regime_flip_to_contango)
